senses.gloss: , read בַּרְגִּימִינִין or בַּרְגִּימִינָא m. pl. (farcimen,—ina) stuffings of sausage, sausages.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:28">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כד מקטע ב׳</he> when cutting the sausages through (dividing them off), v. <cite ref="B00037"><he>באנטרין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:5:2">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite> bot. the sausage-maker is forbidden to work on a Holy Day <he>משום מקטע ב׳</he> because he cuts the sausage-bags apart; v. <cite ref="O00813"><he>סיקורא</he></cite>.
